parserChangeIWillMake.scope: ONLY how --rerun reads the runner's stdout for the single group it just ran. parseReceiptGroups (the receipt reader), evaluateExactMain, resolveMilestone, MILESTONE_LADDER, the archive shape, check mode, the head-mismatch refusal and the idle wait are all untouched.
parserChangeIWillMake.newExport: parseRunnerOutput({ group, output }) -> { group, passed, failed }. It first looks for the existing labelled form through parseReceiptGroups, so an injected runner or a receipt-style line that already says '<group>: N passed' keeps its exact current reading; only when no labelled row for that group exists does it aggregate Playwright's bare summary lines and attribute them to the group the contract just ran.
parserChangeIWillMake.bareSummaryGrammar: A line whose whole content is `<n> passed (<duration>)`, `<n> failed`, `<n> flaky`, `<n> skipped` or `<n> did not run`, with only leading whitespace before the count and nothing after the token but an optional parenthesised duration. Playwright's list and line reporters print exactly these.

countingDecision.flaky: adds to FAILED - a flaky row passed only on retry, which is not the 'ran clean against this exact commit' that E2E-80 asks for. This is the charter's recommended reading and is pinned.
countingDecision.didNotRun: adds to FAILED - an interrupted run left tests unexecuted, so the group is not proven. Fail-closed, consistent with the module's stated posture.
countingDecision.skipped: adds to NEITHER - a skipped test is a declared non-run, not a failure, and it must not be able to zero out a real pass.

parserChangeIWillMake.noSummaryAtAll: unchanged from U9: passed 0, failed 0, never coverage.

risksForTheParent: The real ladder runner is still NOT spawned in this lane - the charter forbids a Playwright run here. The rerun branch is exercised only through an injected fake runner that reprints the real runner's bytes. The first real exercise is the parent's main proof, exactly as it was for U9; if the fix is wrong it will show up there and nowhere earlier.

The verbatim pin case copies the last ten lines of exact-main-rerun-smoke.log, which carry ANSI escape sequences and micro-second WebServer noise. Those bytes are the point of the case: if the parser can be fooled by the noise the case fails. But it also means the case is bound to ONE captured run's spelling; a future Playwright version that changes the summary wording would pass this pin and still break the real rerun.

The summary is attributed to the single group --rerun just ran. That attribution is only sound because runGroup runs exactly one group per child process. If a future change ever runs two groups in one runner invocation, the bare-summary branch would credit both to one name. Recorded as a standing constraint, not defended by code, because the loop's runner takes one --group.

Counting 'did not run' as failed is a decision this unit makes without a captured example - no log in the ledger contains that line. It is fail-closed, so the failure mode is a false MISSING, never a false SATISFIED.

The default archive dir is still gitignored (U9 finding F2). An archive receipt written by --rerun still does not reach main on its own; copying it into the tracked evidence dir remains the loop's job and is not implemented here.
Coverage still does not exist for smoke on any merge commit in the ledger (U9 finding F3). This unit makes a passing rerun READABLE; it does not create the receipt.
